newsitem.title: USA: Automatic Data to up stake in Brazil unit.
newsitem.headline: Automatic Data to up stake in Brazil unit.

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc said Friday it agreed with certain principals of Rede Brasil Sul to increase its ownership of ADP Systems Empresa de Computacao SA from 14 percent to 95 percent.
The company did not disclose financial information on the deal.
The company said the deal will add more than 2,500 clients and $60 million of annual revenue to its employer services business.
ADP Systems is a payroll, human resources and accounting services provider in Brazil.
Brasil Sul is a media group in Brazil with four newspapers, 18 broadcast TV stations, 18 AM and FM radio stations and a growing presence in telecommunications.
In addition, ADP said it completed its previously announced acquisition of the payroll business of Royal Bank of Canada.
The deal will add more than 15,000 clients and $50 million of annual revenue to its employer services business.
